verdict.rationale: Mirrors lets teams write routing conditions that fire automatically when a matching situation comes up mid-conversation. Activation needs no redeploy, routing runs locally, and conditions can be previewed against stored traces before going live. The actions are limited to context edits: appending guidance, editing tool descriptions, tightening schemas, or rewriting tool results. It is not a general event-to-action automation engine. Missing for 10: arbitrary or external actions (e.g. webhooks or integrations), documentation of the rule syntax and event types, a programmatic rules API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
